omittedParts.drums: Retain all GM percussion in the complete private source; omit it from this three-voice tonal interpretation to reserve independent melody, upper accompaniment and main bass. This loses the source drum groove, fills and final percussion-only tail through source beat 353.3125; no invented pitched percussion replaces it.
omittedParts.second-bass: Retain the later layered bass in the complete private source; omit it to preserve the continuous synth-bass part and the independent marimba/high-lead contrast. This loses its additional low-register pitches, simultaneous layering and overlapping tails.
omittedParts.noise-sweep: Retain the percussion-channel sweep events in the complete private source; omit them because their repeated MIDI note does not encode the original noise timbre and no fourth independent voice is available. This loses both source transition sweeps rather than presenting the repeated note as pitched melody.
